picks.excerpt: The BAFTA TV Awards has added an AI clause to its entry rules, requiring entrants to account for generative AI used in a production. HBO Max shows also become eligible for the first time.
picks.rationale: A binding awards-body rule: productions must now disclose generative AI use, which changes how post teams document their pipeline from today.

picks.excerpt: MZed's AI Masking course adds lessons on Premiere Pro's native AI object masking and on handling overlapping performances in DaVinci Resolve. The update tracks how fast AI roto and masking are being absorbed into standard NLE workflows.
picks.rationale: Most directly actionable item in the pool — native AI object masking in Premiere and overlapping-performance handling in Resolve are craft techniques an editor can apply tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: Inside Google's Flow Sessions, the residency-style program that hands filmmakers Veo and Flow and screens the results. It doubles as a showcase for how badly Google wants the film industry to build on its generative video stack.
picks.rationale: Rare inside look at how a model vendor is seeding a filmmaking toolchain — a concrete access route to Veo/Flow and a signal of where studio pipelines get locked in.

picks.excerpt: A hands-on test of xAI's new AI video tool from a filmmaking perspective, judging shot control, consistency and whether the output survives an edit. Curious Refuge compares it against the current model leaders.
picks.rationale: A working AI-film school stress-tests a brand-new video model on shot control and edit survivability — the practical verdict before anyone commits a shoot to it.

picks.excerpt: Higgsfield has inked likeness deals for AI avatars of streamer N3on and UFC fighters Israel Adesanya and Quinton 'Rampage' Jackson. The project is a test for how public figures can get paid to see their likenesses and scripts adapted with generative AI.
picks.rationale: First workable template for paid likeness licensing in generative video — sets the rights precedent any producer casting an AI avatar will have to follow.
